title: QA Test Case History
description: Drilldown target: the full run history of one specific test case (pass/fail timeline, duration, error messages, and a direct link to the GitHub Actions run / commit). Reached by clicking a test name in 'QA Automation KPIs' -- Flaky test leaderboard, Recent failures, or Failures matching selected tag(s) -- or pick a repo/suite/test manually below.

list.name: repo
list.label: Repo
list.query: SELECT id FROM repos ORDER BY 1

list.name: suite
list.label: Suite
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT suite FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: test_name
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT test_name FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT branch FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(case when status='passed' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*) filter (where status in ('passed','failed')), 0), 1) AS pass_rate FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND branch IN (${branch:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS total_runs FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND branch IN (${branch:sqlstring})

SELECT round(avg(duration_ms)) AS mean_duration FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND branch IN (${branch:sqlstring}) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) AS is_flaky FROM flaky_tests WHERE is_active = true AND repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND branch IN (${branch:sqlstring})

panels.title: Result timeline
panels.description: One block per run, colored by outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_started_at AS time, branch AS metric, status AS value FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND branch IN (${branch:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Run history
panels.description: Every run of this test in the selected range. 'CI Run' opens the GitHub Actions run; 'Commit' opens the commit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vtcr.run_started_at AS time, vtcr.branch, vtcr.status, vtcr.duration_ms, vtcr.commit_sha, vtcr.error_message, tr.workflow_run_id AS ci_run, r.github_org, r.github_repo FROM v_test_case_results vtcr JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.id = vtcr.test_run_id JOIN repos r ON r.id = vtcr.repo_id WHERE vtcr.repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND vtcr.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND vtcr.test_name IN (${test_name:sqlstring}) AND vtcr.branch IN (${branch:sqlstring}) ORDER BY vtcr.run_started_at DESC LIMIT 50
